title: The list
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, abandoned summer camp in deep winter, snow-buried log cabins, a frozen lake ringed by black pines, cold moonlight against warm firelight, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. Twelve counselors from 1981 just signed in. 📋

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: smoke rose from a locked cabin at Camp Pine Hollow, and someone rang the dinner bell across the frozen lake.
scenes.image: smoke rising from a lone log cabin, an iron bell on a post across a frozen lake

scenes.narration: By the time Sam reached the bell, the rope was still swinging. The snow beneath it was perfect. Unbroken.
scenes.image: an old iron camp bell with its rope swaying above smooth, untouched snow

scenes.narration: He called the owner. The owner laughed too fast. It's the wind, Sam. It's always the wind out there. Then he hung up.
scenes.image: a man holding a phone to his ear in a dim camp office, frost on the window behind him

scenes.narration: By morning, the smoke was gone. The stove in cabin seven was cold. But the padlock was hanging open.
scenes.image: an open padlock hanging from the hasp of a weathered cabin door in morning light

scenes.narration: Inside, on a nail by the door, hung a clipboard. A sign-in sheet. The paper was crisp and white. The ink was still wet.
scenes.image: a clipboard hanging on a nail inside a cabin door, paper with blurred illegible handwriting

scenes.narration: Twelve names. Camp nicknames. Moose. Sunny. Red. Doc.
scenes.image: a dim cabin interior with twelve neatly made bunks, pale morning light through frosted windows

scenes.narration: In the office, Sam dug out a footlocker of old staff photos. Summer, 1981. Twelve young counselors in matching sweatshirts, squinting into the sun.
scenes.image: a faded 1980s photograph of young adult camp counselors in matching sweatshirts on a sunny dock

scenes.narration: The owner had mentioned the camp closed for two summers in the eighties. He never said why.
scenes.image: an empty boarded-up camp office with dusty trophies and a stopped wall clock with no numbers

scenes.narration: Beside every name on the sheet was a time. Signed in, eleven forty-seven. Last night.
scenes.image: close-up of a man's face lit by a lantern, staring at a clipboard in disbelief

scenes.narration: And at the bottom, one line was still blank. Next to it, in neat block letters, someone had written: Caretaker.
scenes.image: a pen hanging on a string from a clipboard, swaying gently in a dark cabin doorway
